lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows; a prominent cluster of four high-luminance spots forms a sub-rectangular pattern immediately posterior to the upper segments of the fourth and fifth gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a localized grid-like arrangement most visible in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge feature is visible along the upper dorsal-lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with a high-luminance crest and a shadowed trough below.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient in spot size is visible, transitioning from high-density, low-diameter spots on the anterior-most visible section of the head to larger, more widely spaced spots on the posterior flank.
